speaker: Narrator
text: Arriving at their next destination, Mercury, the Astronaut immediately noticed an unusual stillness across the planet. As he parked the spaceship, Nova murmured beside him.

speaker: Nova
text: Did you know that Mercury serves as the central supply hub for every planet?

speaker: Y/N
text: Is that because they handle all the interplanetary transport and logistics?

speaker: Nova
text: Exactly. But because of the unexpected AstroLink outage, all transportation between the planets is currently on a strict hiatus. They canâ€™t process or deliver any shipments.

speaker: Narrator
text: As they stepped out to investigate the silent transport bays, a distressed voice echoed from the distance.

speaker: Nova
text: Huh? Who could that be?

speaker: Narrator
text: Following the commotion, they were greeted by a man dressed in a lab gown, wearing the largest goggles they had ever seen, frantically pacing around a patch of dried, withered plants.

speaker: Narrator
text: Seeing the duo approach, he stopped his panicked muttering and pushed his goggles up onto his forehead.
And you guys are?

speaker: Y/N
text: Iâ€™m Y/N, and this is my partner Nova. We were sent to help with the AstroLink crisis. Can you tell us what happened over here?

speaker: Professor Dominic
text: Oh! My goodness! Saviors! Can you guys help me with our biodome terminal? Ohâ€”I forgot my manners! I am Professor Dominic, head botanist of Mercury.

speaker: Narrator
text: He dramatically pointed to a shattered control panel on the ground.

speaker: Nova
text: Nice to meet you, Professor. What happened to the terminal?

speaker: Professor Dominic
text: While I was doing my daily inspection, a solar storm struck out of nowhere! It completely fried the Biodomeâ€™s Document Object Model, the DOM terminal that controls the life support for these plants. Without it, the environment is collapsing!

title: Mini-Game 1: The Biodome Terminal
objective: The player learns how JavaScript targets HTML elements (using getElementById or querySelector) to "select" the dying plants and inject life-saving data back into them.

speaker: Professor Dominic
text: Oh, marvelous! The biodome terminal is back!

speaker: Narrator
text: The surrounding flora quickly regained its vibrant color. His celebration was cut short by a frantic buzz from his pocket. Dominic answered, his face suddenly going pale.

speaker: Professor Dominic
text: I have been informed that the solar storm melted the logic boards on the AstroLink factoryâ€™s main conveyor belt. They have no idea how to route the incoming materials.

speaker: Narrator
text: Grabbing his keys, Dominic quickly escorted the duo to the massive manufacturing facility.

speaker: Professor Dominic
text: Follow me.

speaker: Narrator
text: He led the duo inside the cavernous factory to the jammed tracks.

title: Mini-Game 2: The Conveyor Belt
concept: Functions, events, variables and if/else logic
objective: The player must write conditional statements to scan the materials (e.g., If material == "metal" -> route to Factory, Else -> route to storage), wrap them inside a reusable Function, and trigger that function using an Event Listener (like onItemDetected).

speaker: Narrator
text: Professor Dominic inspected the main communication relay.

speaker: Professor Dominic
text: The hardware is functioning perfectly. But the transmission is still failing. We canâ€™t receive any incoming data.

speaker: Narrator
text: Nova, who had remained silent, approached the main terminal.

speaker: Nova
text: It makes no sense for the hardware to work while communication drops.

speaker: Narrator
text: Nova murmured, rapidly analyzing the system. Suddenly, they froze.

speaker: Y/N
text: What is it, Nova?

speaker: Narrator
text: Nova pointed directly at the blank screen.

speaker: Nova
text: The solar storm didnâ€™t just damage the physical machinery. The electromagnetic surge completely wiped the front-end software! Mercury isnâ€™t receiving messages because it no longer has an interface to process and display them.

title: Mini-Game 3: The Boss Level
concept: The full stack (HTML, CSS and JavaScript)
objective: The player must combine HTML, CSS, and JS to rebuild the messaging interface from scratch so the communications can finally come through.

text: Upon receiving the robotic notification, all of them began to rejoice; finally, they had resolved the issue that Mercury had caused.

speaker: Narrator
text: Professor Dominic, tense moments earlier, looked relieved. The Astronaut felt their phone vibrate and quickly answered the phone.

speaker: Oberion
text: Chief Y/N, we have received the signals from the three planets. Congratulations on finishing the three planets.
